integrity: Each of the six documents, two independent standalone Python programs and two matching captured outputs is embedded with its exact byte count and SHA-256. All claims concern the same theorem; no external proof certificate or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite exceptional-pair enumeration holds only for lengths at most seven. Infinite extension proves the existence of pairs with two-step detour, but not an upper bound on all higher-order detours. Historical novelty is conditional on inspected sources and index coverage.
title: The sharp first geodesic detour in prefix-normal word-chain generators
